story.iWant: create the basic Docusaurus project structure with GitHub Pages compatibility
story.soThat: I have a foundation for the blog with proper configuration and can begin local development
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create Project Structure (15 min) - Task 2: Configure Docker Compose (20 min) - Task 3: Configure Node.js Dependencies (20 min) - Task 4: Configure Docusaurus (20 min) - Task 5: Configure Git (10 min) - Task 6: Create Documentation (30 min) - Task 7: Validate Environment (30 min)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC-1.1.1: Docker Compose Configuration - docker-compose.yml file created with node:20-alpine image - docker-compose up successfully starts Docusaurus dev server on container port 3000 (mapped to host port 3001) - Built-in hot reload accessible via the dev server (no separate port required) - Working directory /app configured - Volume mounts .:/app and /app/node_modules configured for file sharing - Command runs npm install then npm start -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
AC-1.1.2: Project Directory Structure - blog/ directory created for published articles - Drafts supported via draft: true frontmatter (no separate directory required) - static/img/ directory created for article images - build/ directory excluded from Git (build output) - .docusaurus/ cache directory excluded from Git
AC-1.1.3: Git Configuration - .gitignore file created - .gitignore includes /build, /node_modules, .docusaurus - .gitignore includes other Docusaurus/Node build artifacts - Git repository initialized (if not already)
AC-1.1.4: Node.js Dependencies - package.json created with Docusaurus 3.9 (@docusaurus/core) dependency - package.json includes @docusaurus/preset-classic - package.json includes react and react-dom - package.json includes @mdx-js/react and prism-react-renderer - TypeScript dev dependencies included (typescript, @docusaurus/tsconfig, @docusaurus/module-type-aliases)
AC-1.1.5: Docusaurus Configuration - docusaurus.config.ts created with basic site metadata - Site title: "Personal Technical Blog" - Content format: Markdown/MDX - Preset: @docusaurus/preset-classic - Built-in features configured: RSS/Atom feed, sitemap (via preset-classic) - sidebars.ts created for docs navigation
AC-1.1.6: Documentation - README.md created with setup instructions - README documents Docker Compose workflow (docker-compose up) - README documents local preview URL (http://localhost:3001) - README explains draft (draft: true) vs published post workflow - README includes troubleshooting section (port conflicts, Docker setup)
AC-1.1.7: Performance Validation - Local environment starts in <30 seconds from docker-compose up command - Docusaurus dev server reports "Docusaurus website is running" message - Browser can access http://localhost:3001 successfully - No errors in Docker Compose logs during startup

package.name: @docusaurus/preset-classic
package.purpose: Default theme, blog, docs, RSS/Atom feed, sitemap

image.name: node
image.purpose: Official Node.js 20 Docker image with npm pre-installed

story-context.constraints: - MUST use Docusaurus 3.9 for the React + TypeScript static site deployed to GitHub Pages (ADR-001) - MUST use default @docusaurus/preset-classic theme (no customization for MVP) - Docker Compose environment must match the production GitHub Pages build - All content must be Markdown/MDX with YAML frontmatter - Docusaurus version pinned to 3.9 in package.json - Docker image must be node:20-alpine (specific tag, not latest) - Local environment must work cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows) - Performance: Docker Compose startup <30 seconds (NFR-1) - Performance: Hot reload cycle <5 seconds (NFR-1) - File naming: Blog posts must follow YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md format - Git: /build, /node_modules, .docusaurus must be excluded - No secrets in docusaurus.config.ts or committed files
story-context.interfaces: - Docusaurus CLI (npm scripts): npm start, npm run build, npm run serve, npm run clear - Docker Compose CLI: docker-compose up, docker-compose down - Docusaurus dev server: http://localhost:3001 (host) / http://localhost:3000 (container) - Hot reload WebSocket: served by the dev server (auto-refresh) - File system: Input from blog/, docs/, and src/pages/, output to build/

tests.standards: Epic 1 is foundational infrastructure with manual validation for all acceptance criteria. No automated testing for local development setup. Test approach includes: environment setup testing, configuration testing, content authoring testing, workflow testing, and performance testing. All tests are manual validation with clear success criteria defined in the tech spec.
tests.locations: N/A - This story involves infrastructure setup only. Future stories will add tests in standard Docusaurus/Node locations.
tests.ideas: - AC-1.1.1: Manual test - Run docker-compose up and verify server starts within 30 seconds on host port 3001 - AC-1.1.1: Manual test - Verify hot reload works when files change (via browser DevTools) - AC-1.1.2: Manual test - Verify all directories created (blog/, docs/, static/img/) - AC-1.1.3: Manual test - Verify .gitignore excludes build/ and .docusaurus/ (run git status to confirm) - AC-1.1.4: Manual test - Verify package.json is valid JSON and contains all required dependencies - AC-1.1.5: Manual test - Verify docusaurus.config.ts is valid and Docusaurus builds successfully - AC-1.1.6: Manual test - Follow README instructions from scratch to verify completeness - AC-1.1.7: Performance test - Measure startup time from docker-compose up to "Docusaurus website is running" message (must be <30 seconds) - Error case test - Start another service on port 3001 and verify clear error message about port conflict - Cross-platform test - Test on macOS, Linux, and/or Windows (if available)
